patModal.title: How to create a Personal Access Token
patModal.intro: Create a PAT in Azure DevOps to authenticate ADOLens with your organization.
patModal.step1: In Azure DevOps, open User settings (top right) → Personal access tokens.
patModal.step2: Click New token. Give it a name and choose an expiration.
patModal.step3: Under Scopes, select Custom defined and enable the permissions below.
patModal.step4: Create the token and paste it into ADOLens. Store it securely.
patModal.librariesPermission: Library (Variable Groups): Read & execute, and Read & write for Variable Groups — to view and edit variable groups.
patModal.profilePermission: User Profile: Read — to identify your user and access organization resources.
